steps.content:
You can buy from either seller. On the pages I could see, the two listings are identical.

| | Brackmoor Sound (a) | Ottervale Audio (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Specs and box contents | Same | Same |

Both listings show the same product, the Quellwyn Stillwave H2 in graphite. The 4.3 rating from 210 reviews is also identical. It may be a product-level rating shared across sellers, not a rating of each seller. That means it may tell you nothing about either seller's service.

Nothing on these pages separates the sellers. I'd decide on things the listings don't show:
- **Seller reputation:** look for seller-specific reviews or ratings on the marketplace.
- **Checkout costs:** taxes, or any fees that appear only at checkout, could differ.
- **Return policy details:** check for restocking fees or stricter conditions in the full policy.
- **Warranty:** confirm that the seller or manufacturer honors it, and that the unit is new and not refurbished.

If everything else is equal, pick whichever seller has the better track record. If you can't find any difference, either is fine.
